response.original_title: ((File™Complaint)) How to file a complaint with Viking Cruises?
response.overview: To file a complaint with Viking Cruises, +1-866-829-1280 contact Customer Relations via email at customerrelations@Viking.com for post-cruise issues. For immediate or pre-cruise concerns, call 1-866-Viking Cruises (+1-866-829-1280). For escalated issues, +1-866-829-1280 a primary contact is Collin Steinke, Director of Customer Relations, at 24305 Town Center Drive, Santa Clarita, CA 91355. Customer Service (Phone): +1-866-829-1280 (5 AM – 9 PM PT Mon-Fri; 6 AM – 6 PM PT Sat-Sun). Pre-Cruise: Call the general +1-866-829-1280 number to be transferred to the correct department. To file a complaint with Viking Cruises, email customerrelations@Viking.com with your booking details, or call +1-866-829-1280 for phone support.
